summary.description: What this step wrote, and where.

newRows.description: The id of every registry row filed in this work that the registry did not have before it, said again in full in each report; empty where none was filed or the repository keeps no registry.

preExisting.description: Issues you met that were there before this run - outside what it changed - each reported and never fixed by you. Empty where you met none.

title.description: One line: what is wrong, and where.

description.description: What is wrong and what it causes, as you saw it.

where.description: The paths, from the repository's root, or the command.

evidence.description: What you read or ran and saw, quoted: the file and its lines, or the command and what it printed.

blocks.description: True only where it stops your own work.
